name: works
intendedUse: Compact Wolfsblvt Works umbrella identity for social, provider, project-picker and footer icon slots where the formal lockup is unsuitable.
modifications: Icon-slot translation of the Works mark from the marks and sponsor-assets return: the two open corners and the offset dot at (12.8, 13), redrawn on the 24 grid with 2px round strokes. The return's fixed width and height were removed.

redistribution.notes: Original geometry is distributed from this repository with the package source. The full WOLFSBLVT / WORKS lockups and the coloured mark remain reserved Works identity outside this package.

authoringNotes: Keeps the mark's own construction (two corners that do not close, one dot off centre) instead of a WW monogram, so the glyph reads as the Works maker mark beside GitHub and Discord without replacing the lockup.
